## What and why

Step 01 was a prerequisite for `close-stamp-gaps-for-skeleton` and
`create-engine-skeleton`, not a separate roadmap feature. It set the order:
agree on the generic contracts, record repository-local work and safe test
boundaries, then pass tested producer pins to consumers. This kept the hub plan
from authorizing package changes and kept stamp as the only rebuild authority.

**Owner:** The M2 plan assigns responsibility to package maintainers and a
user-selected integration owner; individual assignments are `UNKNOWN` in that
plan. Andres is the decision owner for the outstanding D5/D8 questions.
**Recorder:** The pipsystem discussion worker captured the October 14 outcome;
its individual identity is `UNKNOWN`. This page is a pipsystem backfill.

## Inputs and outputs

**Inputs:** Approved M0/M1 policy, the umbrella plan's proposed contracts,
read-only package API and test-setup observations, and direct user choices.

**Outputs:** The dated discussion record, proposed local work orders, and a list
of approvals still needed. The selected example is narrow: when upstream A
advances but rerun B has the same result, calculation fingerprint, and
result-relevant metadata, retain B's output version so C need not rerun just
because A changed. A separate proposal preference blocks on missing requested
fingerprint proof and allows recovery of missing saved proof. The discussion
did not approve the full D5 contract or D8 work gates. The later stamp-local plan
records separate execution approval, including exact D5 revisions and its local
test gate; that approval did not come from the discussion alone.

## Verification and gaps

**2026-11-25 pinned-record check: PASS.** The umbrella plan requires separate
local approval. The discussion records the user's choice of the upstream-only
case and explicitly withholds full D5/D8 and implementation approval. The later
stamp Plan identifies a separate October 15 execution approval. These records
support the approval boundary, not blanket approval of all downstream work.

**Runtime: NOT RUN.** This check concerns a decision record; no R package was
loaded (loaded version and build SHA `UNKNOWN`). The discussion itself ran no
fixtures, package integration, live DLW, or production storage checks.

**Gaps:** Ownership and safe runtime were not established across all repositories
in the discussion. Its choice does not settle cutoff after B's own calculation
changes, M1 row-level invalidation, or later end-to-end acceptance.
